items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 3 May 2026 5:02am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 03 May 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Occasional outbreaks of rain will continue through the morning before largely petering out this afternoon, but remaining fairly cloudy. Temperatures up to 15°C, in a light to moderate northeast wind.


##Outlook##

A cloudy start to Bank Holiday Monday, but dry with sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate northerly winds with a top temperature up to 14°C.

Mainly dry and bright on Tuesday with some sunny spells. Light to moderate north or northwest winds increasing moderate to fresh and with top temperatures of around 13°C.
